name: Fill the Beat
original_name: จังหวะรักต่างเจน
overview:
When Keyta, a Gen Z young man who firmly believes in music theory and dreams of studying abroad, is sent by his mother to live with Grandpa Chan, his strict grandfather and the owner of “Rak Thoe Samoe Jai,” a musical instrument repair shop, he finds himself sharing a home with a man whose heart belongs entirely to the classic songs of Suntharaporn.

Their reunion after ten years is not merely a chance to revive old memories. It becomes a major “generation shock,” turning the old wooden house into a battlefield of clashing ideas.
